semantics.behavior: When ring is 0 both outputs are 0. When ring is 1 and vibrate_mode is 0, ringer is 1 and motor is 0. When both inputs are 1, ringer is 0 and motor is 1.
semantics.timing: Outputs follow current inputs after combinational settling; no clock cycles or registered latency.
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior.
semantics.initialization: No state or initialization requirement; outputs derive from inputs.

numeric.arithmetic: Only Boolean inversion and conjunction; no arithmetic, overflow, rounding or saturation.
numeric.unknown_inputs: Specification constrains binary inputs only; no additional X/Z behavior required.

verification.oracle: Independent explicit truth table indexed by ring and vibrate_mode: 00 -> outputs 00, 01 -> 00, 10 -> 10, 11 -> 01 (output order ringer,motor).
verification.coverage: Check all four binary input pairs and all sixteen directed transitions between input pairs after settling.
verification.invariants: Outputs never both asserted; either output asserted exactly when ring is asserted.
verification.tools: Icarus Verilog v12 with -g2012 and explicit dev_tb top; matching vvp; finite shell timeouts for compilation and simulation.
verification.scope: Local independent development verification only; no official evaluation or synthesis.
